relationMerges.rationale: The retired Midway row's Harrison Street period is an asset-level instance of Harrison Street's continuing ownership in the same Harrison Street–1547 platform; the canonical platform period began with the partnership's first 2020 acquisition and remains active.
Both milestones describe the November 2021 four-asset acquisition that added Midway/CHIL1 to the Harrison Street–1547 platform.
The retired row's portfolio-scale statement is supporting detail for the same November 2021 platform expansion preserved in the canonical milestone.

rationale: Merge the standalone Midway Technology Centre record into the existing Harrison Street–1547 Data Center & Connectivity Platform. Direct transaction-party evidence establishes that Midway/CHIL1 was one of four facilities sold by CIM Group to the Harrison Street–1547 joint venture on November 2, 2021, with 1547 continuing as manager. Preserve Midway Technology Centre, Midway Technology Center and CHIL1 as facility aliases, retain the platform's separate Harrison Street and 1547 ownership periods, and do not infer Harrison Street ownership of corporate 1547, a Harrison Street Digital Fund attribution, or an ownership exit from the facility's live sale marketing. No buyer or later closing was identified through August 19, 2026.

beforeImage.name: Harrison Street–1547 Data Center & Connectivity Platform
beforeImage.description: The Harrison Street–1547 Data Center & Connectivity Platform is a U.S. portfolio of carrier-neutral data centers and interconnection facilities held through asset-level joint ventures and operated by FifteenFortySeven Critical Systems Realty. The partnership began with its September 3, 2020 acquisition of the Wells carrier hotel in Milwaukee and later expanded through properties including Pittock Block, AlohaNAP, DRFortress and facilities in Chicago, Orangeburg, Wyoming, Michigan, South Bend and McAllen. 1547 reports more than 1.25 million square feet under management. Harrison Street and 1547 are current co-owners, but exact platform stakes, the Harrison Street fund and any umbrella legal entity are not publicly disclosed. Corporate 1547 is the operator and sponsor rather than a company proven to be owned by Harrison Street, and the individual facilities are assets within the platform. No platform-level sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 19, 2026.

milestones.event: Harrison Street and 1547 completed their first joint acquisition, the Wells carrier hotel and data center in Milwaukee.
The partnership acquired four additional facilities from CIM Group, expanding the Harrison Street–1547 venture to six data centers while 1547 remained operator.
Harrison Street and 1547 added AlohaNAP to their joint national connectivity platform, which then exceeded one million square feet.
Harrison Street and 1547 announced full occupancy and a further expansion at the Orangeburg data center, confirming continuing joint platform activity.
